title: AI System Plan
description: Input shape for scripts/ai_system_audit.mjs — a normalized description of an LLM application's BUILD-quality gates (eval harness, retrieval measurement, grounding, hallucination guardrails, fallback, streaming UX, injection defense, cost ceiling, tool validation). NOT infra/framework selection (see agentic-infrastructure-2026's infra-plan.schema.json for that).

systemType.description: What kind of AI system this plan describes.

factualClaimsMade.description: True (default assumption if omitted) if the system's output makes assertions a user could rely on as fact. Set false only for purely creative/generative output where grounding does not apply.

interactive.description: True (default assumption if omitted) if the system has a live, user-facing turn where perceived latency matters. Set false for offline/batch pipelines.

acceptsUntrustedInput.description: True (default assumption if omitted) if any part of the prompt (user text, retrieved documents, tool output) originates outside your own trusted code.

exists.description: True if a repeatable evaluation harness (not ad hoc manual spot-checks) exists.

used.description: True if the system performs retrieval (RAG) at all.

citationsRequired.description: True if the system is required to cite/attribute the source it grounded a claim in.

sourceAttributionEnforced.description: True if the citation requirement is enforced (e.g. output validated to reference retrieved sources), not just documented as a goal.

enforced.description: True if the design commits to and enforces a per-request cost ceiling. NOT the same as agentic-infrastructure-2026's operational cost controls (kill switch, budget alerts, quotas) — this is the build-time design commitment those infra controls later enforce at runtime.

validationLayer.description: True if tool calls are validated against a real schema before execution (guards against the Tool Hallucination Loop failure mode).
